checks.name: documents: generated upload/read preserves UTF-8 bytes

limitations: Local API checks do not validate Terraform apply, real IAM, account policy, region availability, networking, billing or production operations.
Synthetic client credentials are not deployment identities.
Only the explicit private object storage contract is exercised; other provider services are not emulated.
Azure Entra authorization, custom role enforcement, storage-account versioning and soft-delete retention remain unverified; Azurite CRUD does not establish these behaviors.
message: Generated client functions exercised against local storage APIs. Review the unverified boundaries before planning deployment.
